title: Boundary wall length no more than two-thirds of the boundary (R80, R100, R160, note 4)
text: A 2.4.1 Development complies with the side and rear setbacks set out in Table 2.1, except where: (a) modified by the local planning framework, in which case development complies with the side and rear setbacks set out in the applicable local planning instrument AND/OR (b) a greater setback is required to address 3.5 Visual privacy.

exceptions.label: Table 2.1 note 2: wall abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of equal or greater proportions

replaces.note: Volume 2 note 3: wall on one boundary only, max 2/3 length; draft note 4: both side boundaries, max 2/3 length

notes: Note 4 ('Boundary wall permitted to both side boundaries, and shall not exceed 2/3 length') sits on the R80, R100 and R160 cells only; the LR1, MR1, MR2 and HR cells carry no length or number-of-boundaries limit. verify: note 4 is ambiguous whether 2/3 applies to each boundary or combined (C4P2-028); read as each wall against the boundary it abuts, 66.67%. Walls on both side boundaries are permitted for these codes, so building.boundary_wall_both_sides is not tested. The Table of Changes says only R100 and R160 get two boundary walls (C4P2-028).

verified.note: superscript 4 confirmed on the R80, R100 and R160 boundary wall cells only (LR1, MR1, MR2, HR cells carry none). Note 4 'Boundary wall permitted to both side boundaries, and shall not exceed 2/3 length' does not say 2/3 of what (each boundary or both combined) and is silent on rear boundaries.
